categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Huaye Plastics Machinery Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of core components for plastic molding equipment, primarily screws, barrels, and tie bars used in injection molding machines and extrusion machines. The company operates within the plastic machinery parts industry, focusing on customized manufacturing of these critical parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced manufacturing technologies including multi-axis linkage screw polishing, wear-resistant layer production for barrels and screws, and embedded wear strips for twin-screw barrels. It employs high-precision machining, heat treatment, plasma and laser welding, PVD coating, nitriding, and electroplating to enhance product durability and performance. The production process integrates traditional centrifugal casting with innovative alloy composition and surface treatment techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international plastic molding equipment manufacturers such as Engel, Husky, KraussMaffei, Demag, Milacron, Davis-Standard, as well as major Chinese companies like Yizumi, Haitian, FCS, Datong Machinery, Terry Machinery, Huayan Precision, and Chen Hsong. The end markets served include automotive, household appliances, 3C products, plastic packaging, and plastic building materials.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China with significant sales concentrated in East China and South China regions, accounting for over 90% of revenue. It also exports products to countries including Canada, the United States, Germany, India, and Japan, establishing a global supply footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Huaye operates in the midstream segment of the plastic machinery supply chain, manufacturing core components (screws, barrels, tie bars) that are essential parts of plastic molding equipment assembled and sold by downstream plastic machinery manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on developing high-performance, energy-efficient, and customized core components. R&D priorities include advanced screw and barrel designs for high molecular weight polymers, surface treatment technologies, and integration of digital and intelligent manufacturing systems. Talent development and industrial internet platform construction for supply chain collaboration are also strategic initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized core components (screws, barrels, tie bars) to plastic molding equipment manufacturers. The company follows a make-to-order production model based on customer orders and forecasts, with direct sales as the main channel supplemented by distributors and trade partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in the plastic machinery parts industry in China, holding the top market share for screws and barrels domestically. It competes with both domestic and international component suppliers but distinguishes itself through advanced technology, product quality, and strong relationships with global plastic machinery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Zhejiang Huaye reported revenues of approximately RMB 892 million, a 21.2% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 93 million, up 32.2%. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume and production capacity, with expanding market share and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, durable, and customized core components with superior wear resistance and mechanical properties exceeding industry standards. Its proprietary manufacturing technologies and strict quality control ensure enhanced product lifespan and molding efficiency, providing customers with reliable, high-performance parts tailored to their specific equipment needs.
